titles.title: Community and Residents Education at Hazardous Waste Sites Act of 1992
Community and Residents Education at Hazardous Waste Sites Act of 1992

To amend the Solid Waste Disposal Act to ensure that resident and community interests are fully considered during corrective action at hazardous waste sites, to assist affected residents in better understanding health risks posed by hazardous waste sites, to add additional requirements and authority to the Agency for Toxic Substances and Disease Registry, and for other purposes.
